ownerConfirmation.source: User message: THERM-A-REST XTHERM NXT — FINAL PRODUCT REVIEW
ownerConfirmation.warningProvenance: Explicit owner transcription of Amazon product details; absent from the earlier screenshot

officialSources.findings: Model 14016, Regular Wide, Neptune, 0.54 kg, R 7.3. Extreme-cold marketing is present; no numeric minimum-use temperature reconciling the retailer warning was found.
Standardized R-value measures pad insulation; ground and personal/environmental variables prevent a universal temperature rating.
ASTM F3340-18 supports like-for-like pad R-value comparisons, not a model-specific safe air-temperature cutoff.

decision.matchedProduct: Therm-a-Rest NeoAir XTherm NXT insulated sleeping pad
decision.selectionNote: Amazon warning reported by the owner: Do not use below −20 °C. Therm-a-Rest has not confirmed that use below this threshold is permitted. R 7.3 does not establish a safe air temperature, including at or above −20 °C. The owner confirms B0CS54SN91 as model 14016, Regular Wide / Neptune, 540 g, R 7.3. This is a product-page link; confirm the current selected size, colour and package on Amazon.
decision.safetyReason: Permit only a documented product-page link with the owner-reported prohibition on use below −20 °C displayed before the button. Official model specifications and owner listing details support the destination identity; R 7.3 and extreme-cold marketing do not authorize use below that limit or establish safety above it. Full safety and editorial approval remain pending.

remainingManufacturerEvidence: Written Therm-a-Rest guidance applicable to NeoAir XTherm NXT model 14016 is required to reconcile the Amazon prohibition on use below −20 °C: confirm whether it is a product-use limit, its conditions and which current instructions govern. Until then, preserve the prohibition and do not claim suitability below it.
unchangedLimitations: Ground insulation is one part of a sleep system, not protection against every cold-weather hazard.
Inspect for leaks and carry an appropriate repair and backup plan.
No hands-on or temperature-performance testing has been conducted by ApocalypseGearLab.
